title: codex_topic
_what: ⛔ SNG-658 §2 — ONE THING THE CHARACTER HAS COME TO KNOW, in `character.codex.topics`. ⚠️ The codex is a CONTAINER (schemaVersion, topics, mergeUndo, swept, refused, deferredMysteries); a topic is what lives under `topics`. My first census iterated the container itself and reported 37 of 37 'invalid' on a shape nobody stores — and because the extractor was wrong, the census could not correct the first draft of this file, which I wrote from imagination (`title`, `body`, `lines`, `pinned` — none of them exist). Measured now.
_derivedFrom: All 501 codex topics across the 16 live saves, 2026-09-26; each description says how often the field is actually present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

label.description: 100% — what the topic is called, as the player reads it.

kind.description: 100% — what sort of knowledge it is: event · person · place · thing · idea.

facts.description: 100% — what is known, one line at a time, each stamped with the day it was learned. This IS the topic; everything else is about it.

links.description: 100% — other topics this one touches. ⚠️ A non-array value is replaced rather than trusted, so `links: null` cannot poison a read.

aliases.description: 97% — other names this topic has gone by, so the same knowledge does not open twice.

entityId.description: 48% — the person, place or thing it is about, when it is about one.

reference.description: 14% — a reference topic rather than something learned in play.

summarisedAt.description: 6% — how many facts had accumulated when it was last summarised.

archive.description: 5% — facts folded into the summary, kept rather than dropped.

summary.description: 5% — the short form, once it has grown long enough to need one.

summaryDay.description: 5% — the day that summary was written.
